page.title: Publish a new version
page.intro: Describe the dataset once in the guided form, or paste a Croissant 1.1 manifest you already have. Either way the platform validates it against Croissant, RAI, BIOCroissant and the bio-prov provenance profile before it goes into the catalogue.
page.uploadDescription: Optional. Host the data on this platform instead of pointing the manifest at an upstream URL. Each upload yields a stable contentUrl for the next version’s manifest.

mode.label: Manifest entry mode
mode.pasteDescription: The same validation runs as in the wizard; the paste form is for hosts who already hold a Croissant manifest.

pasteForm.notesHint: Optional. What changed since the previous version?
pasteForm.manifestHint: Paste the JSON-LD here, or upload a .json file to populate the field.

wizard.showJson: Show the JSON-LD generated so far

provenance.label: Provenance
provenance.subtitle: Origin, processing, ethics approval, labelling protocol (bio-prov)

identification.name: Dataset name
identification.descriptionHint: What’s in the dataset, who collected it, and why.
identification.homepageHint: The dataset’s canonical landing page (Croissant 1.0 requires this).
identification.citeAsHint: Optional. The citation string downstream consumers should use.

creators.intro: Authors and contributing organisations. At least one is required.
creators.name: Name

biomedical.intro: BioCroissant fields. Helps researchers find datasets matching their study population, and improves search relevance. Skip the ones that don’t apply.
biomedical.imagingModalityHint: One per comma. e.g. X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, fundus.
biomedical.bodyRegionHint: One per comma. e.g. chest, retina, abdomen.
biomedical.diseaseConditionHint: One per comma. e.g. pneumonia, diabetic retinopathy.
biomedical.anonymizationLevelHint: How identifiable individuals in this dataset are. The Provenance step asks what was done to reach this level.

dataUse.introRestricted: GA4GH Data Use Ontology terms. Pick a permission (one) and any restrictions / modifiers that apply. Hosts of RESTRICTED / PRIVATE datasets must declare at least one term — the publish endpoint fail-closes without it.
dataUse.introPublic: GA4GH Data Use Ontology terms. Pick a permission (one) and any restrictions / modifiers that apply. Hosts of PUBLIC datasets must declare at least one term — the publish endpoint fail-closes without it.
dataUse.requiredTitle: At least one DUO term required
dataUse.requiredBody: This dataset is non-PUBLIC. Pick at least one term below.

distributions.intro: Files in this version. Each entry becomes a Croissant FileObject. For platform-hosted bytes, publish a first version, upload the file via the Upload card on the publish page, and paste the resulting contentUrl here when you publish the next version.
distributions.croissantIdHint: URL-safe identifier for this file inside the manifest.

review.readyBody: The platform validates the manifest below against Croissant 1.1 + RAI + BioCroissant + the OCI publish-time checks (e.g. DUO required for non-PUBLIC). The generated JSON-LD is below; you can copy it and use the paste form for further edits if needed.
review.name: Name

uploader.howBody: Files upload directly to platform storage in chunks of ~16 MB. Browsers handle ~50 GB per session reliably; for terabyte datasets, use the CLI (queued — #88). After upload, paste each contentUrl below into your Croissant manifest’s distribution[].

errors.onlyHostsPublish: Only hosts can publish dataset versions.
errors.manifestRequired: paste or upload a Croissant manifest JSON
errors.apiBaseUrlMissing: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL not set in web env.
errors.preflightInvalid: Could not check provenance: invalid request.
errors.preflightNotJson: Could not check provenance: manifest is not valid JSON.
